Raised around his father's car dealership, he studied business administration at FUMEC. He remains a Localiza shareholder and vice-chairman, with interests in vehicle and truck dealerships.

long_biography.plain_text:
Car-rental entrepreneur Luis Fernando Porto treated used-car sales as an operating priority. At Locamerica, he accelerated fleet replacement to reduce maintenance costs and depreciation. Bulk-purchase discounts helped the company resell some vehicles for more than their original cost. He expanded its sales outlets and planned to test online sales as part of that strategy.

After moving into board work, Porto devoted more time to charitable organisations. He chaired the administrative board of Sistema Divina Providência and served on Mano Down's advisory council. Alongside financial donations, he offered management expertise without charge, aiming to improve the institutions' governance.
